# origincloud_network_nat_gateways (Data Source)

Lists the NAT gateways in a zone, oldest first.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose nat gateways to list.
- `zone` (String) The zone whose nat gateways to list.

### Read-Only

- `nat_gateways` (Attributes List) The nat gateways listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nat_gateways))

<a id="nestedatt--nat_gateways"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nat_gateways`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) When the NAT gateway was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that created the NAT gateway, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`; empty for one the platform created.
- `floating_ip` (String) The floating IP instances behind the gateway appear as, in the same project and zone. It stays allocated when the gateway is deleted.
- `name` (String) The gateway's resource name.
- `subnet` (String) The public subnet the gateway lives in, in the same project and zone.
- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows.
- `urn` (String) The gateway's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.
- `vpc` (String) The subnet's VPC.
